'''Capital City''' was located in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]], and was the home to the [[Sector Performing Arts Center]]. [[Crying Dawn Singer]] was [[Operation 45RA|kidnapped]] from outside the venue before he was due to sing for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]].<ref name="Abduction">[[The Abduction]]</ref>
